text: dsh-erii-boot-splash 是一款面向 DSH Web 的启动动画插件，通过客户端 shell.overlay 槽位显示樱花主题画面。启动时展示飘落花瓣、薄荷色吉祥物、进度条和文字，并在短暂延迟后淡出。动画仅覆盖 Web 界面，可用于为加载过程增添装饰；无需外部服务或密钥，开箱即可呈现轻柔的启动视觉效果。

dsh-erii-boot-splash adds a sakura-themed startup animation to DSH Web. It registers a client component in the shell.overlay slot, showing drifting petals, a mint mascot, a progress bar, and text. The overlay fades away after a short delay. No external service or API key is required.
想给 DSH 网页启动时加一个樱花主题的加载画面。
DSH Web 能显示短暂的启动动画吗？
Can I add a decorative loading splash to the DSH web interface?
dsh-erii-boot-splash 的功能「樱花启动覆盖层」：客户端在 shell.overlay 槽位显示花瓣、吉祥物、进度条与文字组成的动画画面，随后淡出并移除。

dsh-erii-boot-splash README · dsh-erii-boot-splash 🌸：Erii (Sakura) themed **boot splash animation** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com) Web UI.

Every time the page loads, a soft sakura-pink screen fades in: seven petals drift and sway down the viewport while a mint monster mascot — with a cherry blossom on its head — floats gently above a filling progress bar. The whole scene fades out after ~3 seconds and never blocks interaction (`pointer-events: none`).

> *"Sakura 走慢一点。"*

dsh-erii-boot-splash README · Install：From the DSH plugin CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yanglingrise/dsh-erii-boot-splash
```

Or manually:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yanglingrise/dsh-erii-boot-splash.git
cp -r dsh-erii-boot-splash ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/
```Then append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: erii-boot-splash
      name: 'dsh-erii-boot-splash'
```

Restart the Web service (or reload the page after service restart) and enjoy.

dsh-erii-boot-splash README · How it works：- Pure client-side Cordis plugin. The host half is an empty `apply()` so the plugin row mounts; everything renders in the browser.
- Registers one occupant into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` slot with `order: 9999`.
- All animation is CSS keyframes; the stylesheet tag carries `data-plugin="dsh-erii-boot-splash"` and is removed automatically when the plugin unloads.
- Zero runtime dependencies — React is provided by the host module loader.

dsh-erii-boot-splash README · Customize：Open `lib/client.js` and tweak:

| What | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Show duration | `setTimeout(... 2800)` / cleanup at `3700` |
| Colors | The `.esb-*` CSS rules at the top |
| Petal count / speed | The `PETALS` array |
| Title text | `"S a k u r a 加 载 中"` |
| Quote | The `esb-quote` line |
